message.content:
The United States has produced many celebrated composers across a wide range of musical styles. While “most famous” can be subjective and depends on the genre (classical, popular, film, jazz, etc.), here are some of the most widely recognized and influential American composers:

| Composer | Lifespan | Notable Works / Contributions |
|----------|----------|--------------------------------|
| **George Gershwin** (1898–1937) | *Rhapsody in Blue*, *An American in Paris*, *Porgy and Bess* |
| **Aaron Copland** (1900–1990) | *Appalachian Spring*, *Fanfare for the Common Man*, *Rodeo* |
| **Leonard Bernstein** (1918–1990) | *West Side Story* (music & lyrics), *On the Town*, *Candide* |
| **John Williams** (born 1942) | Film scores for *Star Wars*, *Indiana Jones*, *Jurassic Park*, *Harry Potter* |
| **Philip Glass** (born 1937) | Minimalist works such as *Einstein on the Beach*, *Glassworks*, *The Hours* |
| **Samuel Barber** (1910–1981) | *Adagio for Strings*, *Knoxville: Summer of 1915* |
| **Charles Ives** (1874–1954) | *The Unanswered Question*, *The Swimmer*, *Concord Sonata* |
| **John Adams** (born 1947) | *Nixon in China*, *Short Ride in a Fast Machine*, *The Death of Klinghoffer* |
| **Leonard Bernstein** (1918–1990) | *West Side Story*, *On the Town*, *Candide* |
| **Stephen Sondheim** (1930–2021) | *Sweeney Todd*, *Into the Woods*, *Company* (primarily lyricist, but also composer) |
| **George F. C. (G.F.C.)** | *The Music of the United States* (not a composer but a key figure in American music history) |

### Genre‑Specific Highlights

| Genre | Key Figures |
|-------|-------------|
| **Jazz** | Duke Ellington, Miles Davis, John Coltrane, Thelonious Monk, Charlie Parker |
| **Film/TV** | Ennio Morricone (though Italian, his work in Hollywood is iconic), Hans Zimmer (German but major influence), Danny Elfman |
| **Contemporary Classical** | Steve Reich, John Luther Adams, Jennifer Higdon |
| **Popular/Show Tunes** | Cole Porter, Irving Berlin, Stephen Sondheim, Lin-Manuel Miranda |

These composers have left indelible marks on American music and continue to influence musicians worldwide.
